observed.caption: Wide elevated view of a grassy park with scattered trees, covered grandstands and a pond in the foreground, with a dense city skyline under a clear blue sky in the background.
observed.description: In the foreground an expansive patchy grassy field with scattered small leafy trees and a prominent small tree in the lower center extends toward a wide gray paved plaza. Behind the plaza are three long low grandstand structures with light-colored zigzag roofs and tiered seating. Beyond the grandstands a narrow blue pond is visible surrounded by dense green park trees and vegetation. In the background a dense cluster of high-rise buildings of varying heights, colors and designs including brown, red and blue-glass towers lines the horizon under a bright cloudless blue sky in daylight.
